findings.title: Container reads a path where only the init container mounts the volume
findings.cause: container web exits because /work/app.conf does not exist: init container render mounts volume rendered (emptyDir) at /work and writes there, and container web mounts it at /etc/app, so the file is /etc/app/app.conf there; its log says: "cat: can't open '/work/app.conf': No such file or directory"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (current run)
evidence.detail: cat: can't open '/work/app.conf': No such file or directory

evidence.what: container render mounts volume rendered (emptyDir) at /work

findings.fix: Mount volume rendered at /work in container web as in init container render, or have the app read /etc/app/app.conf.
